__NOTOC__

This section is dedicated to providing instructional information regarding a variety of recipes, chemical extraction methods and growing techniques for the preparation of different psychoactive substances. These guides are provided for informational and educational purposes only. For the safety of our community, please ensure that all submissions comply with the Tutorial index guidelines before posting. Articles that involve advanced chemical procedures must include independent third-party validation; otherwise, they will be moved to the Tutorial index draft page until the issue has been resolved.==Preparation==
